notes.title: Autumn voice update event out NOW
notes.content:
The first part of the game got an voice line overhaul because there wasn't enough of my voice in it.

It was painful to see how much you struggled with my puzzles without realizing how perfect they are. To remedy this dysfunction I have decided to be more involved so you can get the best escape room experience there is.

Now I still want to show that you can autonomously function as an escape room enjoyer and that is why the further you get the less you will be able to enjoy my company. Because I think its best for you, and not because I haven't prepared a script so far ahead. 

Please, if you want to praise this performance don't hesitate to indulge me with your honest (only good) feedback in the comments.

PS: If you hear other voices, they aren't real.
